pr_title: Replace XML descriptors for SRE with DynamicDependency attributes

issue_context.title: Mono's ILLink Descriptor is preserving all the fields on Reflection.Emit types
issue_context.body:
See the `preserve="fields"` on these types:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d89772ae2c8ce4f7e0bb7af4891619ff759ee1c0/src/mono/netcore/System.Private.CoreLib/src/ILLink/System.Private.CoreLib.xml#L617-L648

When `Reflection.Emit` is no longer used in an app, `AssemblyBuilder` still gets pulled in because `AssemblyLoadContext::GetRuntimeAssembly` is checking for `AssemblyBuilder`:

```
	Field:System.Reflection.Emit.ILExceptionInfo[] System.Reflection.Emit.ILGenerator::ex_handlers size: 0
	| TypeDef:System.Reflection.Emit.ILGenerator [31 deps]
	| Field:System.Reflection.Emit.ILGenerator System.Reflection.Emit.MethodBuilder::ilgen [1 deps]
	| TypeDef:System.Reflection.Emit.MethodBuilder [48 deps]
	| TypeSpec:System.Reflection.Emit.MethodBuilder[] [3 deps]
	| Field:System.Reflection.Emit.MethodBuilder[] System.Reflection.Emit.TypeBuilder::methods [1 deps]
	| TypeDef:System.Reflection.Emit.TypeBuilder [74 deps]
	| TypeSpec:System.Reflection.Emit.TypeBuilder[] [3 deps]
	| Field:System.Reflection.Emit.TypeBuilder[] System.Reflection.Emit.ModuleBuilder::types [1 deps]
	| TypeDef:System.Reflection.Emit.ModuleBuilder [37 deps]
	| TypeSpec:System.Reflection.Emit.ModuleBuilder[] [1 deps]
	| Field:System.Reflection.Emit.ModuleBuilder[] System.Reflection.Emit.AssemblyBuilder::modules [1 deps]
	| TypeDef:System.Reflection.Emit.AssemblyBuilder [35 deps]
	| Method:System.Reflection.RuntimeAssembly System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext::GetRuntimeAssembly(System.Reflection.Assembly) [1 deps]
	| Method:System.Reflection.RuntimeAssembly System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext::InvokeResolveEvent(System.ResolveEventHandler,System.Reflection.RuntimeAssembly,System.String) [3 deps]
	| Method:System.Reflection.RuntimeAssembly System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext::OnResourceResolve(System.Reflection.RuntimeAssembly,System.String) [1 deps]
	| Other:resource System.Private.CoreLib.xml in System.Private.CoreLib, Version=5.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7cec85d7bea7798e
```

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/acd8e5d4c32b42e0d0ec457e0347f1d9d1eefada/src/mono/netcore/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Runtime/Loader/AssemblyLoadContext.Mono.cs#L170-L177

Since, `AssemblyBuilder`s fields are preserved, it brings in `ModuleBuilder`, and so on.

We should see if we can remove the `preserve="fields"` on these types. I traced it back to the original commit of the linker into the mono repo: https://github.com/mono/mono/commit/00ebb8d9189f76bbae8e1556ac999553d856f72d, but that didn't tell me why these fields need to be preserved.

@marek-safar @vargaz @vitek-karas @MichalStrehovsky

review_comments: Any concerns with the robustness of this, if/when fields are reorganized?
Not really. I think there are enough comments to catch that and right now we keep all fields
